description: This file defines a mock class template `MockStringIterator` for testing purposes, which implements the `WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator` interface using Google Mock. It is used to facilitate unit testing of components interacting with string iterators within the WPEFramework RPC module.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A mock class template implementing `WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator` for testing, providing mocked methods for iteration controls and reference counting.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface based on ID.
